question: Which specialties have a denial rate above 12%?
sql: SELECT p.specialty, AVG(CASE WHEN c.status = 'denied' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS denial_rate FROM claims c JOIN providers p ON p.provider_id = c.provider_id GROUP BY p.specialty HAVING denial_rate > 12 / 100.0 ORDER BY denial_rate DESC

question: Which 5 procedures have the highest total billed amount at out-of-network providers?
sql: SELECT pr.description, SUM(l.line_billed) AS billed FROM claim_lines l JOIN claims c ON c.claim_id = l.claim_id JOIN providers p ON p.provider_id = c.provider_id JOIN procedures pr ON pr.code = l.procedure_code WHERE p.network_status = 'out_of_network' GROUP BY pr.code ORDER BY billed DESC LIMIT 5

question: Top 5 procedures by billed dollars from out-of-network providers
sql: SELECT pr.description, SUM(l.line_billed) AS billed FROM claim_lines l JOIN claims c ON c.claim_id = l.claim_id JOIN providers p ON p.provider_id = c.provider_id JOIN procedures pr ON pr.code = l.procedure_code WHERE p.network_status = 'out_of_network' GROUP BY pr.code ORDER BY billed DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the 5 procedures out-of-network providers billed the most for.
sql: SELECT pr.description, SUM(l.line_billed) AS billed FROM claim_lines l JOIN claims c ON c.claim_id = l.claim_id JOIN providers p ON p.provider_id = c.provider_id JOIN procedures pr ON pr.code = l.procedure_code WHERE p.network_status = 'out_of_network' GROUP BY pr.code ORDER BY billed DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the paid-to-billed ratio for each claim type and network status?
sql: SELECT c.claim_type, p.network_status, SUM(c.paid_amount) / SUM(c.billed_amount) AS ratio FROM claims c JOIN providers p ON p.provider_id = c.provider_id GROUP BY c.claim_type, p.network_status

question: Reimbursement rate by claim type and provider network status
sql: SELECT c.claim_type, p.network_status, SUM(c.paid_amount) / SUM(c.billed_amount) AS ratio FROM claims c JOIN providers p ON p.provider_id = c.provider_id GROUP BY c.claim_type, p.network_status

question: For every claim type and network status combination, compute paid over billed.
sql: SELECT c.claim_type, p.network_status, SUM(c.paid_amount) / SUM(c.billed_amount) AS ratio FROM claims c JOIN providers p ON p.provider_id = c.provider_id GROUP BY c.claim_type, p.network_status
